extras.allergyNote: ⚠️ アレルギー確認要 — Confirm food allergy details with Batur venue before event day.
extras.venueSchedule: 9:30控室前入り → 10:30会場入り準備 → 11:00受付 → 11:30セレモニー開宴 → 12:00飲食提供開始 → 14:30お開き/退場/お見送り → 15:00お見送り終了/着替え/精算 → 15:30退出完了

activities.name: Dressing Room / Rehearsal
activities.nameJa: 控室入り・リハーサル
activities.coordinationNotes: 9:30 Couple arrives at Batur dressing room. Hair, makeup, outfit preparation. Rehearsal from 9:00 if needed.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: 9:30 お二人様控室へのご案内。ヘアメイク・お支度。9:00よりリハーサル実施。

activities.name: Venue Entry / Setup Check
activities.coordinationNotes: 10:30 Enter venue. Verify table setup, flowers, AV/BGM system, seating chart. Coordinate food service timing with venue.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: 10:30 会場入り。テーブルセッティング・フラワー・AV/BGMシステム確認。会場様と食事提供タイミングを事前確認。

activities.name: Guest Reception
activities.coordinationNotes: 11:00 Guest check-in at lobby. Seating chart distribution. 11:20~11:25 standby for ceremony start. Photo/video team positions inside venue.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: 11:00 受付開始。席次表のご案内。11:20〜11:25 スタンバイ。ビデオ・フォトチームは11:25までに会場内でスタンバイ。

staffNotes.photo: Be in position inside venue before 11:25. Capture guests being seated.

activities.name: MC Opening / Welcome
activities.nameJa: MC開会・ウェルカムスピーチ 🎤
activities.coordinationNotes: 11:30 MC opens ceremony from stage right. Welcome address to guests. BGM fades down.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: 11:30 MC（ステージ右側）より開会のご挨拶。ゲストへのウェルカムスピーチ。BGMフェードアウト。

activities.name: Wedding Ceremony
activities.nameJa: ウェディングセレモニー 🎭
activities.coordinationNotes: Wedding ceremony on stage: Vow exchange → Ring exchange → Flower / blessing (15 min total). Ceremony conducted in Myanmar language. MC supports from stage right.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: ステージにてセレモニー。誓いの言葉（ミャンマー語）→ 指輪交換 → 花束贈呈・祝福（合計15分）。MCはステージ右側より進行をサポート。

staffNotes.mc: Cue each step: vow → ring → flower. Support couple with timing.
staffNotes.photo: Front of stage: close-up on vow exchange, ring on finger, flower presentation moment.
staffNotes.lighting: Soft warm ceremony lighting on stage throughout. No sudden changes.

activities.name: Couple Table Greeting Rounds
activities.nameJa: お二人テーブル挨拶回り 🎭
activities.coordinationNotes: 11:50~12:05 Couple visits each table to greet guests (~5 min per table section). Photographer follows.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: 11:50〜12:05 お二人が各テーブルをラウンドしてご挨拶。各テーブル約5分。カメラマン随行。

staffNotes.photo: Follow couple to each table for candid greeting photos. 11:50~12:05.

activities.name: Toast / Campai
activities.nameJa: 乾杯・ウェルカムトースト 🎤 🎭
activities.coordinationNotes: MC leads welcome toast. Campai (~2 min). Food service officially begins at 12:00.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: MCより乾杯のご発声。乾杯（約2分）。12:00 飲食提供スタート。

activities.name: Meal Service + Entertainment Activity
activities.nameJa: 🍽️ お食事タイム・エンターテイメント
activities.coordinationNotes: Food service in progress. MC-led entertainment/activity for guests (~20-40 min, running until ~12:45). Adjust to venue food pacing. Free photo time included.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: 会場様の食事提供タイミングに合わせる。MCによるゲスト参加型エンターテイメント（12:45頃まで、20〜40分程度）。フリー写真タイム含む。

activities.name: Intermission / Dress Change
activities.location: バックステージ・階段
activities.coordinationNotes: ~12:45 Couple exits via staircase for second dress change (~5 min). MC announces brief intermission.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: ★12:45頃 中座。階段経由で控室へ。セカンドドレスへチェンジ（約5分）。MC→ゲストへ中座のアナウンス。階段にスポットライト。

staffNotes.mc: Announce dress change intermission. Keep guests warm with music or light remarks.
staffNotes.lighting: Spotlight on staircase as couple exits

activities.name: Re-entrance (Second Dress)
activities.nameJa: 再入場（セカンドドレス） 🎭
activities.coordinationNotes: ~12:55 Couple re-enters from staircase in second dress. BGM cue on descent.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: ★12:55頃 階段よりセカンドドレスで再入場。BGMのタイミングでご入場。

staffNotes.photo: Position at bottom of staircase. Capture descent and first look in second dress.
staffNotes.lighting: Spotlight down staircase. Warm bright light as couple descends.

activities.name: Cake Cutting
activities.coordinationNotes: Cake cutting → First Bite (groom small spoon / bride large spoon) → First Kiss.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: ★ケーキを準備。ケーキ入刀 → ファーストバイト（新郎→小スプーン、新婦→大スプーン）→ ファーストキス。

staffNotes.photo: Close-up on: cake cutting hands, first bite expressions, first kiss. Do not miss!

activities.name: MC Game
activities.location: 会場・メインテーブル
activities.coordinationNotes: MC-hosted game with guests (~15 min). Game format TBD. Prizes ready.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: ★ギフト用意。MCによるゲスト参加ゲーム（約15分）。ゲーム内容はMCと事前に確認。

activities.name: Table Round Photography
activities.nameJa: テーブルラウンド撮影 🎭
activities.coordinationNotes: Couple visits each table for photos with guests. Photographer follows.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: お二人が各テーブルを訪問し写真撮影。カメラマン随行。テーブル約7卓×10名×1分＝約15分。

staffNotes.photo: Follow couple to each table. Group photos with guests at every table.

activities.name: Thank You Speeches
activities.coordinationNotes: Couple delivers thank you speech in Myanmar language. Family gratitude. MC closes the event.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: ★ティッシュ用意。お二人よりミャンマー語でご家族・ゲストへ感謝のご挨拶。MC閉会のご挨拶。バッキングBGMあり（読み始めに音楽をキュー）。

staffNotes.mc: Cue couple for speech. After their words, deliver warm closing remarks to close the event.

activities.name: All-Guest Group Photo
activities.coordinationNotes: Group photo: all guests + couple + family. Photographer arranges positions.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: 全員集合写真（ゲスト＋お二人＋ご家族）。カメラマンが配置を調整。

staffNotes.photo: Arrange all guests in front of stage for group shot. Coordinate rows and positions.

activities.name: Couple Exit
activities.coordinationNotes: Couple exits the venue. MC announces lobby send-off to guests.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: お二人ご退場。MC→ゲストへロビーでのお見送りをアナウンス。

activities.name: Lobby Send-off & Petit Gifts
activities.nameJa: ロビー送賓・プチギフト
activities.coordinationNotes: Couple stands at lobby entrance to farewell each guest. Petit gift + wedding gift handed to each. Photographer captures farewell moments. 14:30 party officially closes.
activities.coordinationNotesJa: ★引出物の準備。お二人ロビー入口に立ち、退場するゲスト一人ひとりにプチギフト＋引出物を手渡し。カメラマンがお別れシーンを撮影。14:30 パーティーお開き。15:00 お見送り終了予定。

staffNotes.photo: Capture couple's farewell with each guest at lobby exit. Candid emotional moments.
